info.name: Submit a compensation request for a decision

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the resource / event.

items.docs: Send information about a customer-initiated request for compensation (such as a refund or reship) to receive a fraud or abuse decision. Can be submitted at the order level or the item level.

params.name: id
params.description: A unique identifier for the resource / event.

items.docs: Inform Forter of a dispute initiated by a customer, for any dispute not already reported via a payment-processor webhook. No decision is returned; the input improves the model and enables chargeback recovery.
